brief:
Tucker Carlson Network aired a segment featuring host Tucker Carlson in conversation with Joe Kent, a Republican candidate, to discuss U.S. policy toward Israel and its relationship to former President Donald Trump. The discussion examined what Carlson and Kent characterized as Trump's alignment with Israeli interests.

The network provided limited detail on the specific policy arguments or evidence presented during the exchange. The segment was offered as part of Carlson's regular programming, though the full scope of their discussion and the particular claims advanced remained largely unspecified in available summaries.
title: Tucker Carlson questions Trump's approach to Israel policy with Republican candidate.
